messages.author: 9a5e51a082f1eb47
messages.subject: rhdfs set up on windows
parts:
Dear all.

I need Rhadoop on windows server
I am getting this error,please help.


> library(rhdfs)
Loading required package: rJava
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rhdfs', details:
  call: fun(libname, pkgname)
  error: Environment variable HADOOP_CMD must be set before loading package rhdfs

messages.author: 2eaa4556cff0e894
messages.subject: Re: rhdfs set up on windows
parts:
Hi Wu Jerry

This will solve the problem.

In the environment variables please add this variable "HADOOP_CMD=<path of hadoopbin/hadoop file>

ex: HADOOP_CMD=/home/username/hadoop-1.0.3/bin/hadoop

-Ashish Patha
